notes: 8 BRAND NEW MAPS - the old maps are out of the rotation. Every map has three lanes, flank routes between them and one power position that can always be shot back at
SMALL: STACKYARD (container yard with a container tower) and KILLHOUSE (roofless shoot house with an overwatch platform)

MEDIUM: SKYPORT (airport terminal and tarmac), SPIRE (skyscraper rooftop at dusk), DUSTWATER (desert village with a minaret), WHITEOUT (arctic research base), BLACKWATER PIER (harbour, fish market and cannery)
LARGE: RIDGELINE (farm valley split by a river, with four crossings and a barn loft) - built for FFA and long-range fights
Spawns sit behind cover that blocks the long looks into them, and the lobby map picker shows each map's size
